consistency_rule: Single predeclared lower quartile of complete-reference eligible development scores, linear quantile, without any truth or outcome optimisation
marker_rule: Original probe.markers, max 64 reference-only positive LQ specificity genes, at least 8 and two donors
scoring_rule: Only predict original p>=0.001. Keep original negative label. Ineligible/uncertified or either fixed cutoff fail -> ABSTAIN. Neither negative label nor positive label is a calibrated certification.
comparison_rule: Grey-zone absolute log margin. Quantity comparator uses the same mechanism-eligible original positives and preserves original negatives. Both truncate to the final accepted count, with SHA256 of context|sample|label for exact coverage ties, without truth.
score_scope: Separate one-time retrospective replay against already published historical derived truth; formal test gate and sealed truth untouched
